scope: Observed DownloadStream cancellation terminal-result race discovered during workspace regression

initial_failed_run.issue: The cancelled stream completed without its cancellation error

pre_fix_followups.note: Nondeterministic failure retained; a passing recheck was not treated as disproof.

analysis: Inferred from the terminal-state code and observed failure: cancel sets finished and wakes the delegate, then publishes CancellationError after unlocking; the normal completion callback lacked a finished guard and could publish normal EOF first.
fix: didCompleteWithError now returns without publishing when another terminal branch already owns finished. Cancellation owns its waiter and stream result; no error assertion relaxed.
limits: No claim of exhaustive scheduling, actual GUI cancellation or abrupt power-loss coverage in this regression artifact.
